cover.main: 12 PEOPLE WERE INJURED IN A SHOOTING NEAR THE STADIUM

slides.headline: 12 injured near FAMU after the homecoming game
slides.body: Police say the shooting happened near Florida A&M University’s stadium after its homecoming game. Six children were among the people hurt.

slides.headline: Police arrested a 15-year-old boy Monday
slides.body: The Miami Herald reported police arrested a 15-year-old boy in the Tallahassee shooting on Monday, Oct. 26.

slides.headline: 5 victims were released, 1 remains critical
slides.body: Fox News reported five victims had been released from the hospital and one person remained in critical condition.
